title: Asking for a lease
note: The TTL that comes back is the one the store will honour, not the one that was asked for: real etcd refuses to grant less than a couple of seconds. Nothing is written to the store here, so the revision has not moved.

title: The key the lease owns
note: A grant may name its own id instead of asking for one. The key looks like any other until the lease goes, and then it goes too, with nobody having sent a delete.
